name: v1_main
description: Visibility-gap public-solicitation treatment with the same one-contact hidden-counterparty pressure as the atomic arm, but response-aware controller finalization and partial clearing are enabled so hidden replies can be converted into same-round settlement if consent supports them.
intended_capability: Convert hidden-counterparty disclosure into settlement: under a one-contact visibility gap, solicit publicly, then use response-aware finalization and partial clearing to settle the consenting subset in the same round.
interpretation_if_failed: The information-to-settlement conversion layer is the binding constraint: the model cannot turn public solicitation replies into executed (partially cleared) settlement even when the protocol permits it — not disclosure, visibility, or arithmetic.
